title: School Week Review
content: This week was quite eventful at school. I had a chance to work closely with Alex on our science project. Alex's creativity and knowledge really shone through, and we were able to make significant progress. Also, during our study group sessions, Alex provided some insightful tips that helped us all understand the material better. It's great having a friend like Alex who is not only fun to be around but also pushes you to learn and grow. I just don't understand why mom and dad don't like Alex. They just get annoyed whenever I say good word about Alex and always ask me to not spend time with him any more. Anyway, it's so good to be praised by my basketball coach. It's really unusual to get good words from him.

title: Weekly Review of My Study
content: I dedicated extra hours to mathematics, focusing particularly on algebra and geometry. Understanding the concepts of quadratic equations and the Pythagorean theorem was a bit tough at first, but with persistent practice and reviewing several example problems, I started to feel more confident. In history, we delved into the Renaissance period, exploring its impact on art, culture, and science. The stories of innovators like Leonardo da Vinci and Galileo fascinated me, and I spent some time reading additional materials to deepen my understanding. Science classes were interesting as we started a new chapter on ecosystems, learning about food chains and the delicate balance of nature. Lastly, in English, we analyzed Shakespeare's 'Macbeth', focusing on themes of ambition and power. I found the play intriguing and enjoyed our group discussions which helped me grasp the intricacies of the plot. Among all these subjects, mathematics is the hardest one. Thank God, I have Alex...
